title: INC-1042 Payment API runbook
content: INC-1042 runbook for Payment API, last updated 2026-04-14T10:06:00Z. Symptom to identify: checkout requests returned HTTP 503 and p95 latency rose to 8.4 seconds. First verify the time window and inspect INC-1042-LOGS. Test competing hypotheses separately: a network partition between the API and PostgreSQL; a sudden card processor slowdown. Do not treat either as established without matching evidence. Diagnostic confirmation for this incident: pg_stat_activity showed 120 active connections and 340 waiters; payment-api pool_acquire_timeout rose to 42 percent. If confirmed, apply recovery steps: rolled back the pool setting to 80, terminated orphaned long transactions, and added pool saturation alerts. Recheck customer-facing errors and record the resolution timestamp 2026-04-14T10:06:00Z. For causal analysis cite INC-1042-POSTMORTEM. Evidence source ID: INC-1042-RUNBOOK.
